note: WP-6 unit side (mutate-multi.js list key 'wp6-unit', proof null: jest --runTestsByPath the named suite under the proof lock, no database). Mocked-Prisma suites are not certification evidence (plan section 1.4): these entries only show that the unit gate also turns red beside the live catch. They run on the tree the live list runs on (HEAD). Each entry's edits are its live mutant's, byte for byte (mutsyntax-wp6.js checks it); its tests are the titles that must fail, every one checked to exist in its suite at HEAD (mutsyntax-wp6.js). The unmutated suites must pass first (WP6-RUN-PLAN.md section 7.4). Run one id per invocation, quoted and with a trailing comma ("--only=M-CAP,") and always with --lists=<key>: mutate-multi.js matches a value without a comma as a PREFIX (M-DRY would also run M-DRYr, M-DRYs and M-DRYm; M-CAP also M-CAPq, M-CAPa and M-CAPi; M-ORIG also M-ORIG2 and M-ORIG4), PowerShell drops an unquoted trailing comma, and ids such as M1 or G1 repeat across other lists.
